items.title: GPN Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Genius Growth, Margins Rise
items.summary: Global Payments tops Q3 earnings estimates, driven by strong Genius adoption and higher enterprise volumes, while expanding margins and progress on Worldpay integration support growth.

items.title: ALL Q3 Earnings Beat on Protection Services Unit Strength
items.summary: Allstate's Q3 earnings beat estimates by 38.8%, fueled by Protection Services growth and higher investment income, despite surging catastrophe losses.

items.title: Marsh (MRSH) Stock May Be 27% Undervalued Following AltamarCAM Deal

With the spotlight back on how efficiently Marsh turns invested dollars into long term value, the question is whether the current valuation fairly reflects those economics. items.title: Marsh Unveils BrightPath Retirement Solution With $116B in AUM
items.summary: Marsh launches BrightPath, a $116B retirement solution spanning six markets, aiming to boost recurring fee income and strengthen its global retirement business.

items.title: FIS Q3 Earnings Meet Estimates, Revenues Beat on Banking Strength
items.summary: FIS' Q3 earnings meet estimates as revenues jump 27.1% on banking strength, but higher technology spending and conversion delays prompt a 2026 outlook cut.

items.title: Will Property-Liability Underwriting Woes Hurt Allstate's Q3 Results?
items.summary: ALL's Q3 revenues are expected to rise 4.9%, yet Property-Liability underwriting income may plunge 55.7% as earnings are projected to fall 37.1%.

items.title: Will Higher Premiums Help AIG Navigate Q3 Underwriting Pressures?
items.summary: American International faces a Q3 earnings test: higher premiums and investment income may lift revenues, but deteriorating underwriting profitability could pressure profits.

items.title: Can Marsh's Expanded Thrive Program Drive Margin Growth?
items.summary: Marsh raises Thrive's annual savings target 50% to $600 million, but higher restructuring costs and reinvestment could limit the boost to operating margins.
